notes.title: Update 5.0
notes.content:
Today I lauched a new update.

There was alot of feedback about the hitbox of the player, When a player gets hit now he will have a a short cooldown in where he is invincible.

I also fixed the bug where the player 1 controls are switched to arrows in certain levels.

* Hitbox update
* New enemy characters
* 4 New random levels
* Player control fixed (WASD/Arrows)
* New objects added in old levels
* New special weapon added (Magical potion)

Stay tuned for more updates
* Music adjustment
* New level screens
*
